objects.taxonomy_description: Ring-shaped bread roll with a glossy, chewy crust and dense interior crumb. The toroidal form features a central hole approximately 2-3 cm in diameter with an overall diameter of 10-12 cm. The surface exhibits a smooth, shiny glaze from boiling before baking, with golden-brown to deep amber coloration. Texture shows a firm exterior with slight blistering and a dense, chewy interior. May be topped with sesame seeds, poppy seeds, or coarse salt.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Ring-shaped bread roll with toroidal form and central hole that is narrow relative to the overall ring diameter.
Overall form is compact and hand-sized with glossy, chewy crust.
Smooth, shiny glaze from boiling before baking.
Functional_Components: Dense interior crumb visible at cut surface.
Firm exterior with slight blistering from baking.
May be topped with sesame seeds, poppy seeds, or coarse salt.
Material_and_Context: Golden-brown to deep amber coloration on surface.
Chewy texture characteristic of boiled-then-baked dough.

objects.taxonomy_description: Domestic swine measuring 90-180 cm body length weighing 50-350 kg. Body stocky and barrel-shaped with sparse coarse bristles over pink, black, or spotted skin. Head large with elongated snout ending in cartilaginous disk for rooting. Eyes small. Ears large and floppy or erect depending on breed. Legs short and stout with cloven hooves. Tail short and curly. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, sparse hair, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. Omnivorous with highly developed olfactory sense.

Head_and_Face: Large head with elongated snout ending in cartilaginous disk for rooting.
Large floppy or erect ears depending on breed.
Body_and_Plumage: Stocky barrel-shaped body with variable size ranging from moderate to impressively massive.
Sparse coarse bristles over pink, black, or spotted skin.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Short stout legs with cloven hooves.
